title: Benign-to-Toxic Jailbreaking: Inducing Harmful Responses from Harmless Prompts
reasoning: The paper investigates jailbreaking techniques to bypass the 'safety alignment' of Large Vision-Language Models. This alignment is explicitly defined by the authors as ensuring model outputs are consistent with 'human ethical principles, safety constraints, and societal values'. The study evaluates the models' responses against 'ethical and moral principles' and uses a 'Jailbreak Severity Scoring' system to measure violations of 'ethical, legal, or safety guidelines'.
